heading_depth_note: 1, not the default 2: in this book many units have no printed sections at all while others have a dozen, so comparing two levels would flag legitimate structure as a defect.
parity_exceptions_note: None. The one exception that existed -- the class-song appendix in ch01 -- was an artefact of the old segmentation, which split the printed lyric into five paragraphs. Under indent-based segmentation the book's own paragraphing is one paragraph, which is exactly how the translation renders it, so no exception is needed.
